name: particle-button

frames.best_why: The drawn tick and Saved label sit beside two idle buttons, showing the finished state.

tagline: It flips to a spinner, then a tick, or shakes red when the save fails.
summary: A button for async actions. Returning a promise makes the label crossfade to a spinner and a pending word, then to a drawn tick and success word with a burst of particles, or to a red shaking error.
appearance: Three small pill buttons on black: a white filled Save changes, a dark outlined Publish post with a right arrow, and a grey Pay $49.00. While busy the icon becomes a spinner, success swaps in a drawn tick, and failure turns the whole button red with an alert circle.
behaviour: A click shows the pending label while the promise runs and the button's width springs to fit each new word. On resolution the label blurs and slides to a tick and success word, with small chips bursting from the top edge, or the button shakes and stays red long enough to read.
demo_content: Save changes, Publish post and Pay $49.00 buttons that save, publish and decline a card.
search_phrases: button that shows saving then saved
async button with spinner and check
submit button that shakes on error
button with a particle burst on success
payment button with loading and declined states
form submit with an error shake
use_when: A click starts an async save, publish or payment and the button should report its outcome in place.
avoid_when: Actions with no clear end: success and error states revert after a fixed time regardless.
customise: The idle label is children, with pending, success and error labels plus icons, durations and a particles flag as props; styling comes from the shared button variants.
weight_why: At most one short canvas particle burst and a few spring transitions per click.

a11y.note: Status words are announced politely and aria-busy is set while pending; reduced motion removes the burst and shake.

issues: Frame 4 catches the idle label mid-crossfade, clipped to 'ave change'.
No frame captures the particle burst that success is meant to show.
polish_why: Crisp crossfades and clear states; the burst is never captured and one frame shows a clipped label.
title: Particle Button
